observations: Three photos show two car headlamps resting on a tire outdoors.
The headlamps have a dual-circular design typical of BMW E70 X5 models.
The lenses are cloudy and scratched, with visible dirt and wear.
One headlamp (on the right in photo 0) has a noticeable crack or deep scratch on the upper part of the lens.
The housing appears to be black plastic with some metal mounting brackets.
No visible brand or model markings on the headlamps themselves.
Watermark 'CHIDI BMW' is present on all photos, suggesting the seller specializes in BMW parts.
The headlamps are not connected to any wiring harness or bulb assembly; they appear to be bare units.
